endpoints.name: Create a new support ticket

payload.subject: Website navigation issue
payload.description: I'm having trouble navigating through the product catalog. The search functionality doesn't seem to be working properly.

endpoints.description: Creates a new support ticket in the system. The status will automatically be set to OPEN and timestamps will be generated.

endpoints.name: Add a response to a ticket

payload.message: I've tried clearing my browser cache and cookies, but the issue persists. Could you please look into this?

endpoints.description: Adds a new response to an existing ticket. The ticket ID is specified in the URL path.

endpoints.name: Add a support agent response

payload.message: Thank you for providing that information. I've checked our system and found that there's an issue with the search index. Our technical team is working on fixing it. In the meantime, you can use the category navigation on the left side of the page.

endpoints.description: Adds a response from a support agent to the ticket.

endpoints.name: Update ticket status
endpoints.description: Updates the status of a ticket. Valid status values are: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED.

endpoints.name: Mark ticket as resolved
endpoints.description: Marks a ticket as resolved after the issue has been fixed.

curl_examples.name: Create a new ticket
curl_examples.command: curl -X POST http://localhost:8083/tickets -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"customerId\": 1005, \"subject\": \"Website navigation issue\", \"description\": \"I'm having trouble navigating through the product catalog. The search functionality doesn't seem to be working properly.\"}"

curl_examples.name: Add a response to a ticket
curl_examples.command: curl -X POST http://localhost:8083/tickets/1/responses -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"message\": \"I've tried clearing my browser cache and cookies, but the issue persists. Could you please look into this?\", \"responderType\": \"CUSTOMER\", \"responderId\": 1001}"
